confidence_notes: The RBA rate comes from a search of rba.gov.au pages. The result gave AUD/USD 0.6720 for 18 November 2026, and I did not open the page itself. Food and drink anchors come from three web searches: one on the RBA rate and two on Tampa prices. Those results covered Numbeo-based and crowdsourced cost-of-living sites, an older 2023 study, and sample venue menus. Sources differ, and tourist areas such as downtown and waterfront venues run higher. Cocktail and wine figures rest on sparse aggregate data and venue menus, and I set them against the typical $6-7 beer price. The pricing window is July 2026, but the sources are mixed in date. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no live listings checked. Tampa hotel rates vary by season, events and location, so these are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tampa is priced close to the US average. It sits slightly below major tourist cities such as Miami and Orlando theme-park areas for restaurants and drinks. Accommodation is based on typical mid-sized Florida metro rates.
